name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, and Pi. 42 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: A plug-in for AI coding assistants that makes them draw clean, good-looking diagrams (flowcharts, org charts, timelines) that match your brand, instead of ugly default boxes.
buyer: A solo content creator or agency owner who publishes technical blog posts, pitch decks, or client reports and is tired of either fighting Figma for 30 minutes or shipping ugly auto-generated diagrams.
business_use_cases: A content marketing agency uses it to produce on-brand architecture and process diagrams for every client blog post, saving a designer's time on each one.
A startup founder drops it into their docs site build so every 'how it works' diagram matches the site's visual style automatically.
A consultant preparing a client pitch deck generates a clean Wardley map or quadrant chart in minutes instead of commissioning one.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'diagram pack' service: feed in a client's brand site, deliver a finished set of on-brand architecture/flow diagrams for their docs or deck.
Bundle the skill into a premium 'developer docs as a service' subscription for startups who want polished technical content without hiring a designer.

steal_this: Pick 5 common diagram requests (architecture, flowchart, org chart, roadmap, timeline) and offer a $200 flat-rate 'on-brand diagram pack' to indie SaaS founders this weekend.
